$comment: Rules spec v1.0, section 3.11 (mobile, vehicle, house). Element flow matrix confirmed against the benchmark mobile sample (section 1). Pairs not listed are neutral.

goals.$comment: Default goal digit sets from popular practice. Digits opposed to both birth numbers are dropped from a set.

vehicle.$comment: Letters in registrations are converted with Chaldean values (D17).

house.$comment: Flat number first, then building number. A letter suffix (12B) adds its Chaldean value.
